questions.question: Why did the Jewish leaders want Festus to bring Paul from Caesarea to Jerusalem?

answers.text: To ambush and kill him on the way
To have him speak at the temple
To let the high priest question him

questions.question: When Paul's accusers brought charges against him before Festus in Caesarea, what did Paul say in his defense?

answers.text: He had made one honest mistake
He had broken a minor temple rule

questions.question: When Festus asked Paul to go to Jerusalem for trial, where did Paul say he ought to be tried?

answers.text: Before the judgment seat of Caesar

questions.question: After Paul appealed to Caesar, Festus talked with his council and refused to send Paul to Caesar. True or false?
